Premium realistic lifestyle advertising photography, authentic everyday setting, soft daylight, restrained natural warm neutrals with subtle cyan/violet clothing accents, believable human expressions and anatomy. Readable simple narrative in one shot, no collage, no borders, no UI frame, no overlaid text or watermark, no fabricated logos, no documents or legal data. Important faces and action within the central 80% width and 75% height. The Digital ID on the phone is represented simply by a portrait thumbnail and large generic black-and-white QR, pale white/cyan/violet card, without letters or numbers. This is an illustrative scene, not a screenshot recreation. Recurring protagonist for this six-image series: an adult woman around 24, shoulder-length straight chestnut hair, warm brown eyes, ivory T-shirt, muted lilac overshirt, charcoal trousers, friendly natural face, no conspicuous jewelry. No science-fiction holograms, magic particles or large graphic tick overlays. Scene HOTEL, shot 1 of 2, PRESENT ID: modern boutique hotel reception, pale wood and stone counter, calm adult female receptionist in navy jacket. In a medium close 3/4 view, the guest holds her smartphone upright with the Digital ID QR facing a small physical QR scanner on the counter. The reader is distinct from the phone and unobstructed. Their faces are visible, the scanner and phone clearly readable in the center foreground; receptionist attentively checks. A small travel suitcase beside the guest provides the hotel context. Optical 50mm editorial look, crisp action, gently softened background.
